title: ADL real Ollama evidence spiral
objective: Verify the configured Gemma Cloud provider and create one bounded real agent conversation in the ADL application, then verify persisted conversation and trace evidence. Do not read credentials or modify files through the agent.

work_items.title: Freeze provider scope and current runtime identity
done_when: Port 8081 and isolated port 8084 are distinguished
Configured model identity and status are recorded

work_items.title: Verify the configured model through the supported provider check
done_when: Actual configured provider check is executed
Result distinguishes model listing/auth from generation

work_items.title: Run one bounded real turn through an existing ADL agent
deliverables: Real browser turn, screenshot, local trace reference, model/provider identity
done_when: A real Ollama response is returned in ADL
Prompt forbids file mutation and requests a bounded visible result

work_items.title: Verify the conversation and available trace persisted after the real turn
done_when: Conversation and user/assistant messages are read back from backend storage
Provider/model and trace reference are supported by observed data
Missing or unavailable trace fields stay explicit

work_items.title: Independent evidence review and terminal gate
done_when: Real generation is distinguished from mock tests
